ai_summary: Agri-Tech (India) Limited has submitted its routine compliance certificate for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, confirming adherence to SEBI Regulation 74(5) regarding the dematerialization of securities. The certificate verifies that all dematerialization requests were properly processed, confirmed to depositories, listed, and physical certificates were mutilated/cancelled with member registers updated within the stipulated 15-day period. This is a standard regulatory filing indicating sound operational compliance with investor service regulations, presenting no material impacts or red flags.
